description.en:
Xu Jiajia and Duan Xi have been bitter rivals for over a decade, yet once night falls, they tacitly maintain a casual sexual relationship.
After a heated argument, their intimate encounter unexpectedly sends Xu Jiajia back in time to Duan Xi’s innocent youth.
Seeing the young and naive Duan Xi, Xu Jiajia decides to first seduce her, then cast her aside, forcing her into complete submission!
Possessing the soul of a 27-year-old, she faces the brooding, sensitive 20-year-old Duan Xi.

**What begins as revenge and teasing gradually reveals the other’s hidden vulnerability and pain...**

(Source: Bilibili, edited)
description.fr:
Xu JiaJia et Duan Xi sont des rivales de longue date.

En secret, leur relation est bien plus compliquée : elles entretiennent une relation passionnelle mêlant désir, compétition et rancune.

Après une dispute particulièrement violente suivie d'une nuit d'amour, Xu JiaJia est mystérieusement renvoyée plusieurs années dans le passé.

Elle retrouve alors une Duan Xi âgée de seulement vingt ans, encore vulnérable.

Son premier objectif est simple : séduire Duan Xi, la manipuler puis l'abandonner afin de prendre sa revanche.

Mais au fil du temps, elle découvre une facette de Duan Xi qu'elle n'avait jamais connue, et son désir de vengeance commence peu à peu à laisser place à des sentiments plus sincères.

Tao Zhi, an infamous figure in Laboratory School 1, dominated the bottom rankings all year round. One day, according to rumour, Miss Tao somehow fell for the legendary academic big boss—the school’s only hope to defeat neighbouring schools, the top scorer in the college entrance exam: Jiang Qihuai. Fang Wanjie risks everything to raise money for his girlfriend's medical expenses by entering a place called "the Gate". However, he discovers that the high pay was actually a trap. He is then manipulated, humiliated and beaten by his companions, but he persists despite everything. He is then chased and attacked by thousands of monsters. On the verge of death, he awakens an innate talent that allows him to survive in the most perilous situations. As he contemplates leaving "the Gate" to seek revenge, he realizes that the key to opening the gate has been destroyed, leaving him trapped inside, surrounded by monsters. He is determined to survive, fight and become stronger, even if he has to become an undead creature, in order to make those who betrayed him pay.

Translated by Google Translate.
description.fr: Fang Wanjie risque tout pour réunir l’argent nécessaire aux frais médicaux de sa petite amie en entrant dans un endroit appelé « La Porte ». Cependant, il découvre que la rémunération élevée était en fait un piège. Il est alors manipulé, humilié et battu par ses compagnons, mais il persiste malgré tout. Il est ensuite poursuivi et attaqué par des milliers de monstres. Au bord de la mort, il éveille un talent inné qui lui permet de survivre dans les situations les plus périlleuses. Alors qu’il envisage de quitter « La Porte » pour se venger, il réalise que la clé permettant d’ouvrir la porte a été détruite, le laissant piégé à l’intérieur, entouré de monstres. Il est déterminé à survivre, à combattre et à devenir plus fort, même s’il doit devenir une créature morte-vivante, afin de faire payer ceux qui l’ont trahi.
description.pt-br:
Fang Wanjie se arriscou para entrar na 'Porta' a fim de juntar dinheiro para o tratamento médico de sua namorada, mas não sabia que a alta recompensa no início era uma armadilha. Ele foi ridicularizado, humilhado e espancado por seus companheiros. Ele persistiu penosamente, mas foi perseguido e devorado por dezenas de milhares de monstros. À beira da morte, ele despertou seu talento e transformou o perigo em segurança. Quando ele se preparava para sair da 'Porta' para se vingar, descobriu que a chave para abrir a 'Porta' havia sido destruída e ele estava preso dentro da 'Porta' cheia de monstros.

description.en:
You don’t belong to this world, and yet you wish to step onto the path of cultivation. Targeted by the Heavens, they cast a curse on you, one unbreakable even by immortals. All changes in your body will be reversed, and you will no longer be able to cultivate again.

Jiang Chen tries to cultivate, but realises that his spiritual energy flows backwards, and scatters in all directions.

When he was in despair, he was struck by lightning.

[You’ve been struck by lightning, your flesh and blood is eroded and your dantian is shattered. The curse takes effect, and regenerates your body, granting you the power of vitality.]

[Your dantian regenerates, and become invincible.]

[The lost spiritual energy gathers in the body automatically, and flows through the meridians. You’ve stepped into the Qi Refinement stage first layer… second layer… third layer!]

Jiang Chen fell into silence, “???”

I have to cultivate like this?
description.zh: 你本不属此界之人，妄想踏入修行之路，被天道盯上，降下万道诅咒，仙不可破，你身上出现任何变化都将反转，一生无法踏入修行之路。】 姜尘尝试修炼，发现灵气倒流，溃散四方。 心中绝望时，一道落雷击中。 【你被落雷击中，血肉糜烂，丹田破碎，诅咒生效，肉身修复，获得生机之力。】 　　【丹田恢复，蕴上大道规则，无坚不摧。】 【流失灵气，自动集身，贯通经脉，踏入练气一层……二层……三层！】 姜尘陷入沉默：“？？？” 合着，我要这样修炼？

description.en:
The Yanhuang Ancient Domain, vast without end, gave birth to many Celestials and Demons of antiquity tore Heaven and Earth apart and surpassed the control of the 3 Realms and 5 Elements over the endless years it has existed. Numerous Gods, more than ten thousand races, and humans born with a God class body have also come out from the Domain, traveling through the nether, warping Yin and Yang, omnipotent.

In this current age, Celestial Daoism is in prosperity, tens of thousands of Divine techniques shake the Heavens, numerous mortals strive to become Celestials, and millions of sinners walk the Earth. The Prince Heir of the kingdom East Yue Wu Wu Yu, obtains the legacy of the Battle Celestial of the East in the direst of situations to sweep across the Earth and rebel against the Heavens!

In the eyes of the hundreds of millions of Mortals, he is the Sovereign Emperor Celestial, overcoming a plethora of tribulations to reach his current height.

In the eyes of the Celestials and Buddhas of Heaven, he is a peerless Heaven devouring Demon!

---

**Note:** Addendum on the "Manji" visible in chapter 2, for those uninformed:
"In East Asia the manji (卍) is an ancient religious symbol of power and good fortune for many different countries and religions around the world, including Buddhism, Hinduism, Jainism, and a number of Indo-European and Native American religions as well."
"The specific meaning of the symbol varies by nation and religion, and also by the position of the "arms" of the cross--whether they face left or right, or whether the cross is tilted or straight."
"In the 1930s, the swastika symbol--a clockwise, tilted cross--was adopted by the Nazi Political Party in Germany, and gained a negative reputation as a symbol of hatred in the modern world."
description.zh: 吞天记：这是一个仙魔纵横的世界，炎黄古域，浩瀚无边，无尽岁月中诞生诸多太古仙妖，撕裂天地，超脱三界五行。更有万物神灵，天生神体，穿梭虚空，逆乱阴阳，无所不能。当今乃仙道盛世，万法通天，众生修道，妖孽横行！东吴太子吴煜于绝境中得东方绝世战仙之衣钵，自此横空出世，逆天崛起。

Mo Shiyi's dreamed to marry a tall, rich, and handsome man and strived to reach the top in life. description.en:
What should you do if transmigrated to a fantasy world and has become a son called the 'Human Race's Great Traitor'!

Don't worry, looking at his infinite epiphany system, all Bai Mo needs to do is to make others jealous of him!

No matter what kind of moves and cheats, as long as someone is jealous of him, Bai Mo can start an epiphany and let himself practice those to perfection in an instant!

So Bai Mo raised a lot of big villains around him, and occasionally molested them.

He liked to watch his enemies jealous and resentful of him, but they couldn't do that themselves!
description.id: Apa yang harus saya lakukan jika saya menjadi putra seorang yang dikenal sebagai pengkhianat umat manusia di dunia fantasi!  Jangan khawatir, melihat sistem pencerahannya yang tak terbatas, yang perlu dilakukan Bai Mo hanyalah membuat orang lain iri padanya!  Tidak peduli keterampilan atau buku rahasia apa pun, selama seseorang iri padanya, Bai Mo akan dapat membuka pencerahannya dan membiarkan dirinya mengembangkannya dengan sempurna dalam sekejap!  Oleh karena itu, Bai Mo telah mengangkat banyak penjahat besar di sekitarnya, dan sesekali menggodanya, dia suka melihat musuhnya iri dan membencinya, tetapi dia tidak bisa bertindak seperti dirinya sendiri!
description.vi: Ta nên làm gì nếu xung quanh chỉ toàn là kẻ thù? đừng lo lắng, chỉ cần dựa vào hệ thống đốn ngộ vô hạn, tất cả những gì bạch mỗ cần làm là khiến người khác ghen ăn tức ở với hắn! hấp thụ ghen ghét hắn sẽ học được bất kỳ bí kỹ nào chỉ trong nháy mắt, thoả mãn tu luyện bản thân. vì vậy hắn nuôi rất nhiều kẻ thù ở xung quanh, để hắn đi cà khịa...
description.zh: 越玄幻世界还变成了被称为人族大叛徒的儿子该怎么办！ 不急，看着自己的无限顿悟系统，白墨需要做的就是让别人嫉妒自己！无论何等功法、秘籍，只要有人嫉妒他，白墨就能开启顿悟，让自己瞬间将它修炼圆满！ 于是白墨身边养了很多大反派，偶尔调戏一下，就喜欢看着敌人嫉妒怨恨自己，却又干不了自己的样子！

description.en: Fiendfire’s rank 1 player Tu Lan received an SOS message from his brother Tu Mu while spending his time in the game… When he logged off to investigate, his “brother” was already replaced by someone else. So Tu Lan logged onto the game to rescue the real Tu Mu. But not only was he demoted to Lv1 and couldn’t log off, but he also needed to escape from the threat that is his max level avatar…

Three years ago, he harvested a spiritual fruit, but was snatched by a Shoushan disciple. Three years later, the Moriyama disciple became the most dazzling genius in the sect, but he discovered that the spirit fruit that was taken away was only one ten thousandth of the chance he had obtained. Since then, he has risen like a comet, opening a fabulous road against the sky!

One day, Zhang Fan, a diaosi programmer, was confused by the Yellow River Chenghuang and was drawn into the netherworld exchange group. Since joining this group, Zhang Fan has "continuous crises". He has encountered the lady who jumped off the building, the doctor who was almost hacked to death, and was often beaten… Is this the rhythm of death? Zhang Fan "risked his death" to cultivate immortals and staged a dumbfounding pretend drama. See how the ordinary and inexperienced young Zhang Fan step by step from the face-slapped dick to the face-slapped king!

Crackhead rom-com, a modern re-tail of The Little Mermaid. Featuring a delusional mermaid, and a whimsy "prince".  
  
Dans le conte de la petite sirène il est dit : « Elle sauta dans la mer et quand le soleil se leva, elle se transforma en écume. ». STOP! Ici on va vous raconter une autre histoire, la petite sirène a de la ressource et le prince charmant ne l'est pas tant que ça…
